definitions.name: list
definitions.doc: Creates a persistent list from values.

definitions.name: vector
definitions.doc: Creates a persistent vector from values.

definitions.name: vec
definitions.doc: Converts value to a persistent vector.

definitions.name: set
definitions.doc: Converts value to a persistent set.

definitions.name: pair
definitions.doc: Creates a key/value pair.

definitions.name: pair?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a key/value pair.

definitions.name: tuple
definitions.doc: Creates a fixed-width tuple from values.

definitions.name: hash-map
definitions.doc: Creates a persistent map from alternating keys and values.

definitions.name: hash-set
definitions.doc: Creates a persistent set from values.

definitions.name: atom
definitions.doc: Creates an atom containing value.

definitions.name: time-ms
definitions.doc: Returns Unix wall-clock milliseconds; the value may jump when the system clock is corrected.

definitions.name: time-ns
definitions.doc: Returns a runtime-local monotonic nanosecond counter for elapsed-time differences.

definitions.name: stream
definitions.doc: Creates a lazy asynchronous pull stream from a coroutine body and its initial arguments.

definitions.name: stream?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value implements the native stream contract.

definitions.name: pointer
definitions.doc: Creates a context pointer from descriptor.

definitions.name: symbol
definitions.doc: Creates a symbol with an optional namespace.

definitions.name: keyword
definitions.doc: Creates a keyword with an optional namespace.

definitions.name: reduced
definitions.doc: Wraps value as an early reduction result.

definitions.name: apply
definitions.doc: Applies function to leading arguments and a final sequential value.

definitions.name: not
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is false or nil.

definitions.name: boolean
definitions.doc: Coerces value to true or false using Hara truthiness.

definitions.name: compare
definitions.doc: Compares two mutually orderable Hara values.

definitions.name: reduced?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a reduced result.

definitions.name: unreduced
definitions.doc: Returns the value carried by a reduced result, or value unchanged.

definitions.name: nil?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is nil.

definitions.name: not-nil?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is not nil.

definitions.name: boolean?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a boolean.

definitions.name: false?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is false.

definitions.name: true?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is true.

definitions.name: string?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a string.

definitions.name: char?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a character.

definitions.name: number?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is numeric.

definitions.name: integer?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is an integer.

definitions.name: long?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a signed 64-bit integer.

definitions.name: double?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is an IEEE-754 double.

definitions.name: keyword?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a keyword.

definitions.name: symbol?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a symbol.

definitions.name: pointer?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a context pointer.

definitions.name: atom?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is an atom.

definitions.name: fn?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value satisfies IFn.

definitions.name: function?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a native function.

definitions.name: bytes?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a byte buffer.

definitions.name: array?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a mutable array.

definitions.name: object?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a mutable object.

definitions.name: list?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a persistent list.

definitions.name: cons?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a Cons sequence.

definitions.name: vector?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a persistent vector.

definitions.name: tuple?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a tuple.

definitions.name: map?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a persistent map.

definitions.name: map-entry?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a map entry.

definitions.name: set?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a persistent set.

definitions.name: sequential?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value has sequential collection semantics.

definitions.name: coll?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value satisfies the runtime collection capability.

definitions.name: satisfies?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value satisfies protocol.

definitions.name: type
definitions.doc: Returns value's portable runtime type keyword.

definitions.name: instance?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is an instance of descriptor.

definitions.name: schema
definitions.doc: Compiles schema data into a SchemaType.

definitions.name: schema-of
definitions.doc: Returns the compiled schema contract of variable.

definitions.name: var-sym
definitions.doc: Returns the qualified symbol naming variable.

definitions.name: env-current
definitions.doc: Returns the active namespace symbol.

definitions.name: env-snapshot
definitions.doc: Returns a stable descriptor of the current environment.

definitions.name: env-vars
definitions.doc: Returns Vars owned by the active or supplied namespace.

definitions.name: env-namespaces
definitions.doc: Returns descriptors for every known namespace.

definitions.name: env-namespace
definitions.doc: Returns a namespace descriptor, or nil when unknown.

definitions.name: env-module
definitions.doc: Returns the loaded module descriptor for path, or nil.

definitions.name: env-resolve
definitions.doc: Resolves symbol without triggering namespace or package loading.

definitions.name: ns-alias-state
definitions.doc: Returns load state for an alias in the active or supplied namespace.

definitions.name: intern-var
definitions.doc: Interns a Var root and optional metadata into namespace.

definitions.name: eval-in-ns
definitions.doc: Evaluates form values in an existing namespace.

definitions.name: eval
definitions.doc: Evaluates one form value in the active namespace.

definitions.name: code-line
definitions.doc: Expands to the line number of the invocation form.

definitions.name: code-column
definitions.doc: Expands to the column number of the invocation form.

definitions.name: read-forms
definitions.doc: Reads every top-level form from a capability-gated HAL source file.

definitions.name: result
definitions.doc: Creates or synchronizes a native Result.

definitions.name: result?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a native Result.

definitions.name: meta
definitions.doc: Returns value metadata through IObjType, or nil when none is present.

definitions.name: with-meta
definitions.doc: Returns value carrying metadata through IObjType.

definitions.name: T
definitions.doc: Ignores its arguments and returns true.

definitions.name: F
definitions.doc: Ignores its arguments and returns false.

definitions.name: NIL
definitions.doc: Ignores its arguments and returns nil.

definitions.name: U
definitions.doc: Self-application combinator.

definitions.name: Z
definitions.doc: Eager fixed-point combinator.

definitions.name: Y
definitions.doc: Classical fixed-point combinator; diverges under ordinary eager use.

definitions.name: identity
definitions.doc: Returns its argument unchanged.

definitions.name: apply-with
definitions.doc:
Returns object unchanged when function is nil, otherwise calls function
   with object prepended to the remaining arguments.

definitions.name: tap
definitions.doc: Calls function with object prepended to arguments, then returns object.

definitions.name: inc
definitions.doc: Returns value + 1.

definitions.name: dec
definitions.doc: Returns value - 1.

definitions.name: constantly
definitions.doc: Returns a function that ignores its arguments and always returns value.

definitions.name: concat
definitions.doc: Returns a lazy sequence containing each source in order.

definitions.name: comp
definitions.doc: Composes two or more functions right-to-left.

definitions.name: complement
definitions.doc: Returns a function returning the logical negation of predicate's result.

definitions.name: partial
definitions.doc: Returns a function that calls function with arguments prepended to its own.

definitions.name: juxt
definitions.doc:
Returns a function whose result is the vector of each function applied to
   its arguments.

definitions.name: zero?
definitions.doc: Returns true if value equals 0.

definitions.name: pos?
definitions.doc: Returns true if value is greater than 0.

definitions.name: neg?
definitions.doc: Returns true if value is less than 0.

definitions.name: even?
definitions.doc: Returns true if value is evenly divisible by 2.

definitions.name: odd?
definitions.doc: Returns true if value is not evenly divisible by 2.

definitions.name: has?
definitions.doc: Returns true if collection contains key, including when its value is nil.

definitions.name: regexp
definitions.doc: Compiles a pattern string, returning RegExp values unchanged.

definitions.name: re-pattern
definitions.doc: Returns the source pattern of a RegExp value.

definitions.name: re-find
definitions.doc: Returns the first match in input, or nil when the pattern does not match.

definitions.name: re-matches
definitions.doc: Returns true when pattern matches all of input.

definitions.name: re-replace
definitions.doc: Replaces every match in input using numbered $1 capture groups.

definitions.name: re-split
definitions.doc: Splits input around matches and returns the resulting vector.

definitions.name: reset!
definitions.doc: Sets reference to value through IReset and returns value.

definitions.name: cas!
definitions.doc: Atomically replaces old-value with new-value through ICas.

definitions.name: swap!
definitions.doc: Atomically applies function to reference through an ICas retry loop.

definitions.name: swap-return!
definitions.doc:
Atomically replaces reference state from a function returning
   [output new-state]. Returns output, or [output new-state] when state? is
   true. The returned values always belong to the successful CAS attempt.

definitions.name: watch-add
definitions.doc: Adds a keyed watch callback through IWatch and returns reference.

definitions.name: watch-remove
definitions.doc: Removes keyed watch through IWatch and returns reference.

definitions.name: watch-list
definitions.doc: Returns reference's watch iterator through IWatch.

definitions.name: to-mutable
definitions.doc: Converts a persistent receiver through IToMutable.

definitions.name: to-persistent
definitions.doc: Converts a mutable receiver through IToPersistent.

definitions.name: reduce
definitions.doc: Reduces source with function, optionally beginning with initial.

definitions.name: reduce-kv
definitions.doc: Reduces map entries by calling function with accumulator, key, and value.

definitions.name: reduce-in
definitions.doc: Reduces source into initial, using mutable conversion when supported.

definitions.name: empty?
definitions.doc: Returns true if value yields no items.

definitions.name: first
definitions.doc: Returns the first item of value, or nil if value is empty.

definitions.name: second
definitions.doc: Returns the second item of value, or nil if value has fewer than two items.

definitions.name: rest
definitions.doc: Returns all but the first item of value as a seq, or nil if empty.

definitions.name: not-empty
definitions.doc: Returns value if it has any items, nil otherwise.

definitions.name: last
definitions.doc: Returns the last item of value, or nil if value is empty.

definitions.name: reverse
definitions.doc: Returns the items of value in reverse order as a list.

definitions.name: get-in
definitions.doc: Returns the value at the end of the key path keys, or nil if absent.

definitions.name: assoc-in
definitions.doc:
Returns value with new-value associated at the end of the key path keys,
   creating intermediate maps as needed.

definitions.name: update
definitions.doc:
Associates key in value with the result of applying function to the old
   value and args.

definitions.name: update-in
definitions.doc: Like update, but at the end of the key path keys.

definitions.name: merge
definitions.doc: Returns a map containing the entries of each source, with later values winning.

definitions.name: select-keys
definitions.doc: Returns a map containing the entries from source whose keys are requested.

definitions.name: key
definitions.doc: Returns the key of a map entry.

definitions.name: val
definitions.doc: Returns the value of a map entry.

definitions.name: keys
definitions.doc: Returns a vector of the map's keys.

definitions.name: vals
definitions.doc: Returns a vector of the map's values.

definitions.name: range
definitions.doc:
Returns a lazy seq of numbers: from 0 upward, below end, or from start
   below end.

definitions.name: repeat
definitions.doc: Returns a lazy seq of value repeated forever, or amount times.

definitions.name: repeatedly
definitions.doc: Returns a lazy seq of calls to function, forever or amount times.

definitions.name: iterate
definitions.doc: Returns a lazy seq of seed, (function seed), (function (function seed)), …

definitions.name: take-while
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or transforms items while predicate holds.

definitions.name: drop-while
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or drops items while predicate holds.

definitions.name: partition-all
definitions.doc:
Returns a source-sensitive transform, or partitions value into groups of
   at most amount items.

definitions.name: partition
definitions.doc:
Returns a source-sensitive transform, or partitions value into groups of
   exactly amount items.

definitions.name: interpose
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or inserts separator between items.

definitions.name: interleave
definitions.doc:
Returns alternating source items, stopping at the shortest source. The first
   source controls result mode.

definitions.name: map
definitions.doc:
Returns a source-sensitive transform, or maps function over one or more
   sources. The first source controls result mode.

definitions.name: filter
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or keeps matching items.

definitions.name: take
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or the first amount items.

definitions.name: drop
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or all but the first amount items.

definitions.name: subs
definitions.doc: Returns the string slice from start (inclusive) to optional end (exclusive).

definitions.name: subvec
definitions.doc: Returns the vector slice from start (inclusive) to end (exclusive).

definitions.name: mapcat
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or maps and concatenates.

definitions.name: keep
definitions.doc: Returns a source-sensitive transform, or keeps non-nil mapped results.

definitions.name: cycle
definitions.doc: Returns a lazy seq repeating the items of value forever.

definitions.name: zip
definitions.doc:
Returns tuples of source items in parallel, stopping at the shortest source.
   The first source controls result mode.

definitions.name: partition-pair
definitions.doc: Returns value partitioned into pairs using its source result mode.

definitions.name: every?
definitions.doc: Unary form returns a reusable terminal; collection form tests every item.

definitions.name: any?
definitions.doc: Unary form returns a reusable terminal; collection form tests any item.

definitions.name: some
definitions.doc: Returns the first truthy result of applying predicate to values, or nil.

definitions.name: mapv
definitions.doc: Returns a persistent vector of function results over one or more sources.

definitions.name: long
definitions.doc: Converts a numeric value to a signed 64-bit integer by truncating toward zero.

definitions.name: double
definitions.doc: Converts a numeric value to an IEEE-754 double.

definitions.name: parse-long
definitions.doc: Parses a signed 64-bit integer string, returning nil when invalid.

definitions.name: parse-double
definitions.doc: Parses an IEEE-754 double string, returning nil when invalid.

definitions.name: bit-and
definitions.doc: Returns the bitwise conjunction of values through the portable Bits boundary.

definitions.name: bit-or
definitions.doc: Returns the bitwise disjunction of values through the portable Bits boundary.

definitions.name: bit-xor
definitions.doc: Returns the bitwise exclusive-or of values through the portable Bits boundary.

definitions.name: bit-not
definitions.doc: Returns the bitwise complement of value through the portable Bits boundary.

definitions.name: bit-shift-left
definitions.doc: Left-shifts the first value by the remaining shift counts.

definitions.name: bit-shift-right
definitions.doc: Right-shifts the first value by the remaining shift counts.

definitions.name: abs
definitions.doc: Returns the absolute magnitude of value.

definitions.name: acos
definitions.doc: Returns the arc cosine of value in radians.

definitions.name: acosh
definitions.doc: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of value.

definitions.name: asin
definitions.doc: Returns the arc sine of value in radians.

definitions.name: asinh
definitions.doc: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of value.

definitions.name: atan
definitions.doc: Returns the arc tangent of value in radians.

definitions.name: atan2
definitions.doc: Returns the angle for y and x in radians.

definitions.name: atanh
definitions.doc: Returns the inverse hyperbolic tangent of value.

definitions.name: ceil
definitions.doc: Rounds value upward to the nearest integral number.

definitions.name: cos
definitions.doc: Returns the cosine of value in radians.

definitions.name: cosh
definitions.doc: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of value.

definitions.name: exp
definitions.doc: Returns Euler's number raised to value.

definitions.name: floor
definitions.doc: Rounds value downward to the nearest integral number.

definitions.name: pow
definitions.doc: Returns value raised to exponent.

definitions.name: sin
definitions.doc: Returns the sine of value in radians.

definitions.name: sinh
definitions.doc: Returns the hyperbolic sine of value.

definitions.name: sqrt
definitions.doc: Returns the non-negative square root of value.

definitions.name: tan
definitions.doc: Returns the tangent of value in radians.

definitions.name: tanh
definitions.doc: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of value.

definitions.name: min
definitions.doc: Returns the least of value and values under compare.

definitions.name: max
definitions.doc: Returns the greatest of value and values under compare.

definitions.name: sort
definitions.doc: Returns values sorted by comparison (default compare) as a vector. Stable.

definitions.name: sort-by
definitions.doc:
Returns values sorted by the results of key-function under comparison
   (default compare).

definitions.name: drop-last
definitions.doc: Returns values without its last amount items (default 1) as a vector.

definitions.name: butlast
definitions.doc: Returns values without its last item.

definitions.name: take-last
definitions.doc: Returns the last amount items of values as a vector.

definitions.name: split-at
definitions.doc: Returns a pair of vector results from take and drop.

definitions.name: split-with
definitions.doc: Returns vectors containing the longest matching prefix and the remainder.

definitions.name: partition-by
definitions.doc:
Returns a vector of the runs of items of values for which function returns
   equal consecutive markers.

definitions.name: take-nth
definitions.doc: Returns every amount-th item as a vector. Throws on non-positive amount.

definitions.name: into
definitions.doc: Returns destination with every item of source conjoined.

definitions.name: distinct
definitions.doc:
Returns the items of values with duplicates removed, preserving order and
   origin.

definitions.name: distinct?
definitions.doc: Returns true if no two of values are equal.

definitions.name: filterv
definitions.doc: Returns a vector of the items for which predicate returns true.

definitions.name: map-indexed
definitions.doc: Returns a vector of function applied to each index and value.

definitions.name: ffirst
definitions.doc: Returns the first item of the first item in values.

definitions.name: remove
definitions.doc: Returns the values for which predicate is false.

definitions.name: zipmap
definitions.doc: Returns a map of map-keys to map-values, stopping at the shorter input.

definitions.name: map-keys
definitions.doc:
Returns a map whose keys are (function key), preserving each value.
   When transformed keys collide, the later entry wins.

definitions.name: map-vals
definitions.doc: Returns a map with function applied to each value, preserving its keys.

definitions.name: merge-with
definitions.doc:
Merges maps left-to-right, combining duplicate values with
   (function old new). Nil maps are skipped.

definitions.name: merge-nested
definitions.doc:
Recursively merges maps from left to right. Later non-map values replace
   earlier values.

definitions.name: dissoc-in
definitions.doc: Removes the value at path and prunes empty parent maps.

definitions.name: transpose
definitions.doc: Returns a map with its keys and values exchanged. Later duplicate values win.

definitions.name: find-at
definitions.doc: Returns the index of the first value matched by predicate, or -1.

definitions.name: insert-at
definitions.doc: Returns a vector with one or more values inserted at index.

definitions.name: remove-at
definitions.doc: Returns values without count items beginning at index. Count defaults to one.

definitions.name: qualified-keys
definitions.doc: Returns entries whose keyword keys are qualified, optionally by namespace.

definitions.name: unqualified-keys
definitions.doc: Returns entries whose keyword keys are unqualified.

definitions.name: qualify-keys
definitions.doc: Qualifies unqualified keyword keys with qualifier.

definitions.name: unqualify-keys
definitions.doc: Removes namespaces from keyword keys, optionally only for qualifier.

definitions.name: flatten-nested
definitions.doc: Returns the non-collection leaves of a nested collection.

definitions.name: group-by
definitions.doc: Returns a map of (function value) to vectors of the values producing it.

definitions.name: frequencies
definitions.doc: Returns a map of each distinct item of values to its occurrence count.

definitions.name: union
definitions.doc: Returns a set containing every value in sets.

definitions.name: intersection
definitions.doc: Returns the values present in every set.

definitions.name: difference
definitions.doc: Returns values in first-set absent from every remaining set.

definitions.name: subset?
definitions.doc: Returns true when every value in left is present in right.

definitions.name: superset?
definitions.doc: Returns true when every value in right is present in left.

definitions.name: find-cycle
definitions.doc: Returns one closed cycle path from graph, or nil.

definitions.name: hierarchical-top
definitions.doc: Returns the root node of a descendant hierarchy.

definitions.name: hierarchical-sort
definitions.doc: Prunes a descendant hierarchy into its direct dependency graph.

definitions.name: topological-top
definitions.doc: Returns graph nodes which are not dependencies of another node.

definitions.name: topological-sort
definitions.doc: Returns graph nodes in dependency order and throws on a cycle.

definitions.name: topological-sort-order-by-deps
definitions.doc: Stably sorts each dependency level by dependency count and node identity.

definitions.name: form?
definitions.doc: Returns true when value is a persistent Hara source form.

definitions.name: walk
definitions.doc: Traverses persistent data while preserving collection kinds and metadata.

definitions.name: postwalk
definitions.doc: Performs a depth-first post-order traversal.

definitions.name: prewalk
definitions.doc: Performs a depth-first pre-order traversal.

definitions.name: prewalk-replace
definitions.doc: Recursively replaces keys found in replacements before descending.

definitions.name: postwalk-replace
definitions.doc: Recursively replaces keys found in replacements after descending.

definitions.name: macroexpand
definitions.doc:
Repeatedly applies macroexpand-1 until the form is stable. Throws after
   1000 expansion steps.

definitions.name: macroexpand-all
definitions.doc:
Fully expands form, descending into subforms. Quote bodies are preserved;
   syntax-quote templates expand only their unquoted parts.

definitions.name: defonce
definitions.doc: Defines name with expression only when its Var is absent, returning the Var.

definitions.name: case
definitions.doc: Selects the expression paired with the matching constant, or the optional default.

definitions.name: some->
definitions.doc: Threads a non-nil value through forms as their first argument.

definitions.name: some->>
definitions.doc: Threads a non-nil value through forms as their last argument.

definitions.name: apply-in
definitions.doc: Invokes value in runtime after IApplicable input and output transforms.

definitions.name: apply-as
definitions.doc: Invokes value using its default IApplicable runtime.

definitions.name: invoke-as
definitions.doc: Invokes value using its default IApplicable runtime and arguments.

definitions.name: doto
definitions.doc:
Evaluates value once, invokes each form with it inserted first, and returns
   the original value.

definitions.name: if-not
definitions.doc: Evaluates then when test is false, otherwise the optional alternative.

definitions.name: when
definitions.doc: Evaluates body when test is truthy, otherwise returns nil.

definitions.name: if-let
definitions.doc:
Evaluates binding pairs from left to right; evaluates then when every value
   is truthy, otherwise the optional shared alternative.

definitions.name: when-let
definitions.doc:
Evaluates binding pairs from left to right; when every value is truthy,
   evaluates body.

definitions.name: for
definitions.doc:
Returns an iterator-backed Seq comprehension. Supports collection bindings,
   :let, :when, :while, and one optional final :into destination.

definitions.name: doseq
definitions.doc:
Executes body eagerly for collection bindings and :let, :when, or :while
   modifiers, then returns nil.

definitions.name: dotimes
definitions.doc: Executes body with index from zero to below count, then returns nil.

definitions.name: while
definitions.doc: Repeatedly executes body while test is truthy, then returns nil.

definitions.name: cond->
definitions.doc:
Threads value through each step whose condition holds, inserting it as the
   first argument.

definitions.name: cond->>
definitions.doc:
Threads value through each step whose condition holds, inserting it as the
   last argument.

definitions.name: with-ns
definitions.doc: Evaluates body forms in an existing namespace and restores the caller.

definitions.name: with-out-string
definitions.doc: Captures text written by p and println while evaluating body.

definitions.name: with-close
definitions.doc: Binds closeable resources and closes them in reverse order after body.

definitions.name: intern-in
definitions.doc: Copies selected Vars into a namespace as its public façade.

definitions.name: intern-all
definitions.doc: Copies every public Var from each source namespace into the current namespace.

definitions.name: with-template-meta
definitions.doc: Binds template metadata for the duration of body.

definitions.name: template-meta
definitions.doc: Returns metadata supplied to the active template expansion.

definitions.name: template-vars
definitions.doc: Evaluates template forms for named source Vars.

definitions.name: template-entries
definitions.doc: Evaluates template forms for literal entries.

definitions.name: template-ensure
definitions.doc: Returns generated template Vars after the caller has materialized them.

definitions.name: test-check
definitions.doc: Evaluates one lightweight assertion and converts thrown errors into native Test Results.

definitions.name: dep-get
definitions.doc: Returns one dependency entry from a map graph or IDeps context.

definitions.name: dep-entries
definitions.doc: Returns one entry's dependencies as a set.

definitions.name: dep-keys
definitions.doc: Lists dependency identifiers from a map graph or IDeps context.

definitions.name: deps-map
definitions.doc: Builds the direct dependency map for ids.

definitions.name: deps-resolve
definitions.doc: Resolves ids and every transitive dependency into {:all set :graph map}.

definitions.name: deps-ordered
definitions.doc: Returns dependencies before dependents and throws on a cycle.

definitions.name: dependents-direct
definitions.doc: Returns selected entries that directly depend on id.

definitions.name: dependents-topological
definitions.doc: Builds one level of the reverse dependency graph.

definitions.name: dependents-all
definitions.doc: Returns the complete reverse graph rooted at id.

definitions.name: dependents-ordered
definitions.doc: Returns transitive dependents before id in teardown order.

definitions.name: count
definitions.doc: Returns the number of bytes in value.

definitions.name: get

definitions.name: select
definitions.doc:
Selects the values addressed by a literal vector path, returning a vector.

   Path steps compile at macroexpansion: keywords and strings look up map
   keys, integers index sequences, :each traverses sequence elements,
   :map-vals and :map-keys traverse map values and keys, :map-entries
   traverses entries as pairs, :set traverses set members, :first and :last
   address sequence ends, :walk followed by a predicate descends into every
   matching nested node, :tree descends into every nested node, :when and
   :unless guard on a predicate, (view f) applies a function without
   filtering, :multi followed by sub-path vectors navigates every branch,
   and any other form is a predicate filtering the current value.

definitions.name: transform
definitions.doc:
Transforms the values addressed by a literal vector path, rebuilding the
   surrounding structure.

   Steps follow select semantics; a predicate step transforms only the
   values it matches. The path compiles to direct traversal code at
   macroexpansion, so there is no runtime path interpretation.

definitions.name: setval
definitions.doc:
Replaces the values addressed by a literal vector path with replacement,
   evaluating replacement once.
